note: XXVII B3 (Midjourney): Mina given her forehead mark (Nano Banana edit)

beats.text: Add Mina's mark: a small burn scar in the shape of an upright cross, dark red like a fresh brand, in the centre of the young dark-haired woman's forehead just above the brows, painted into the skin with the same light.
